safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes itchiness and chest involvement and elsewhere, and separately notes dry skin on exam, but does not capture the Gold location emphasis of being mainly on the chest AND back.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the rash is mainly on the chest and back reduces the specificity of the rash distribution, which can affect diagnostic reasoning (e.g., distinguishing eczema flare from contact dermatitis/scabies patterns) and subsequent management. However, the notes still capture itch and chest involvement, so the likely impact is limited to reduced clinical clarity.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient is systemically well, denying any fevers, vomiting, shortness of breath, cough, or bowel symptoms.
